title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: when the hazardous-cargo surcharge falls due
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product the hazardous-cargo surcharge row is owed only while the acceptance is approved or loaded, and only once the booking carrying the goods is recorded as loaded, departed or closed. For goods whose booking shows any other status nothing is written yet, and when a hazardous-cargo surcharge row already exists on the acceptance no second one is written.

## Truth table
| Acceptance status | Status of the booking carrying the goods | Surcharge row already on the acceptance | Row owed now |
|---|---|---|---|
| approved or loaded | loaded, departed or closed | no | yes |
| approved or loaded | loaded, departed or closed | yes | no — no second row |
| approved or loaded | any other status | — | not yet |
| any other status | any | — | no |

## Points of judgement
- *The acceptance still shows approved, but the booking already shows departed — is the row owed?* Yes; the acceptance is approved and the booking is recorded as departed.
- *The booking shows gated in?* Not yet; nothing is written until the booking is recorded as loaded, departed or closed.
- *Does an administration-fee row or a marine pollutant row count as an existing hazardous-cargo surcharge row?* No; only a row of the hazardous-cargo surcharge itself stops a second one.
